categories.main_business_segments: Sihui Fuji Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs). Their product portfolio includes high multilayer boards, HDI boards, thick copper boards, metal-based boards, ceramic boards, rigid-flex boards, high-frequency high-speed boards, and embedded copper block boards. The company serves key sectors such as industrial control, automotive electronics, communication equipment, medical devices, new energy, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including Anylayer HDI, Mini LED substrates, carrier boards, long boards up to 2.1 meters, HDI aluminum substrates, 50+ layer boards, PTFE high-frequency boards, embedded ceramic composite substrates, and metal-based rigid-flex boards. They emphasize high-density interconnect (HDI), high-frequency high-speed, thick copper, and embedded heat dissipation technologies. Production methods include multilayer lamination, selective electroplating, and advanced solder mask techniques, supported by continuous R&D and digital transformation of production lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Their primary customers are industrial control and automotive electronics companies, accounting for over 80% of revenue. They have long-term relationships with leading global industrial control firms such as Hitachi, Panasonic, Omron, and Yaskawa, as well as automotive electronics clients including EMS manufacturers and new energy vehicle companies. Other markets served include communication infrastructure, medical devices, AI servers, robotics, and optical communication modules.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Guangdong Province. It has established subsidiaries and production bases in Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, and Thailand, with the Thai production base operational since mid-2024. This 'China+1' strategy supports global customers across Asia, Europe, and North America, providing diversified sourcing options and mitigating regional risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sihui Fuji operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on PCB manufacturing. It sources raw materials such as copper clad laminates and copper foil from upstream suppliers and supplies PCBs to downstream PCBA assemblers and electronic device manufacturers. The company also extends services into PCBA assembly, offering integrated solutions from design to production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality PCB production with continuous R&D investment targeting advanced products like high-layer count boards, HDI, high-frequency, thick copper, and embedded heat dissipation substrates. It focuses on innovation in AI server applications, automotive electronics, and emerging fields such as robotics and optical communication. The strategy includes digital transformation of manufacturing, flexible production lines, and global capacity expansion, especially in Southeast Asia.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of PCBs and related products to industrial customers. The company operates a direct sales model with a focus on customized, high-value products. It also derives income from PCBA assembly services and financial investments, including returns from short-term financial products. Government subsidies and investment income contribute to non-operating revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sihui Fuji is positioned as a high-quality PCB manufacturer within the Chinese domestic market and globally, ranked among the top 25 domestic PCB companies. It competes by focusing on high-reliability, high-precision PCB products for demanding sectors like industrial control and automotive electronics. The company leverages long-term partnerships with leading global customers and differentiates through advanced technology and flexible production capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.41 billion, a 7.5% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 140 million, reflecting a decline due to increased costs and initial fixed costs from new production bases. Total assets reached RMB 2.63 billion, growing 10% from the prior year. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing capacity expansion and R&D investment, despite short-term profit margin pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sihui Fuji emphasizes high-quality, high-reliability PCB products with short lead times and responsive customer service. Its value proposition includes advanced manufacturing capabilities for complex, multilayer, and high-frequency PCBs tailored to industrial control and automotive electronics. The company offers a diversified product range and global production footprint, enabling flexible supply and one-stop solutions from PCB design to assembly, fostering strong customer loyalty and competitive advantage.
